description: Declares event flags by name: a flag is one yes/no fact of the story that the save keeps ("this pickup was taken", "this door is open", "this cutscene was seen"). Scripts test and set them with sh.flag_get / sh.flag_set, map data (events, world objects, spawn rules, the paper map) names them the same way, and a save stores the names of the flags that are set. Each entry: "description" says what sets the flag and what it changes; "aliases" are former names that still resolve everywhere (old saves, scripts and mods); "old_save_names" are former names that now name another flag, so they are read only from saves written before the rename. The engine gives every flag its save bit itself (the original layout of the base flags is the "event_flags" list of original_order.json). A mod adds its own flags with a flags.json or flags/*.json of the same shape in its folder (names are then <mod folder>:Name). Event flags of map6: the Otherworld Resort Area (map6_s00), the boat (map6_s01), the lakeside pier and lighthouse (map6_s02), the sewer to the amusement park (map6_s03) and the amusement park with the Cybil fight (map6_s04): cutscenes, the Channeling Stone spots and pickups.

M6S00_AfterOtherworldAutosaveTaken.description: Set on the first map6_s00 tick after the post-scene warp (M6S00_AfterOtherworldWarpDone), together with an autosave snapshot, so the snapshot is taken once.

M6S00_OtherworldSpreadsCutsceneDone.description: Set during (step 10) and at the end of the scene where the Otherworld spreads over the Resort Area (map6_s00 Cutscene_OtherworldSpreads, RSU.DMS). It starts the warp of event 4, lifts a collision block and stops the loading screen from showing the ground picture.

M6S00_AfterOtherworldWarpDone.description: Completion flag of the map6_s00 warp to point 2 after the Otherworld-spreads scene; it also triggers the one-time autosave (M6S00_AfterOtherworldAutosaveTaken).

M6S02_LighthouseStairFarEndReached.description: Set when Harry reaches the far end of the lighthouse's spiral stair in map6_s02 (sector 6 of the stair cell, the end away from the pier door); cleared when he leaves the stair cell and when the Alessa scene starts. It starts the warp to the lighthouse room at point 3: the first time event 4 (sets M6S02_LighthouseRoomFirstReached), afterwards event 5 (sets M6S02_LighthouseRoomWarpDone).

M6S02_LighthouseRoomWarpDone.description: Completion flag of the repeat warp from the far end of the lighthouse stair to the room at point 3 (event 5); cleared when Harry leaves the stair cell, so the warp works each time.

M6S02_LighthouseRoomStairEntered.description: Set when Harry, in the lighthouse room of map6_s02 (cell around (60, -20)), walks within 1.4 m of the stair opening; it starts the warp back onto the spiral stair (event 6, point 4). Cleared when he leaves the room's cell and at the end of the Alessa scene.

M6S02_LighthouseStairWarpDone.description: Completion flag of the warp from the lighthouse room back onto the spiral stair (event 6); cleared when Harry leaves the room's cell.

M6S02_LighthouseRoomFirstReached.description: Completion flag of the first warp into the lighthouse room of map6_s02 (event 4). It starts the scene where Alessa vanishes in front of Harry (event 7).

M6S02_LighthouseAlessaCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the lighthouse scene where Alessa vanishes ('Damn, I was too late', map6_s02 Cutscene_LighthouseAlessa); it also marks the lighthouse on the resort map. It opens the map6_s00 door to the boat (event 6) and changes the resort music.

M6S00_ManholeCoverRemovedSeen.description: Set when, after Cybil has left the boat (M6S01_CybilLeavesCutsceneDone), Harry examines the opened manhole in map6_s00 (points 12-15, 'The cover has been removed...'). It opens the way down into the sewer to the amusement park (event 17, door to map6_s03).

M6S02_CameraCutThisFrame.description: Per-frame signal of map6_s02's scenes: set on each hard camera cut of the lighthouse and UFO scenes and cleared again at the start of the next tick. The lake surface effect swaps its frame buffer when it is set so the reflection does not smear across the cut.

M6S00_OtherworldSpreadsHarryReacted.description: Set at step 5 of the Otherworld-spreads scene of map6_s00 (after 'What's this?', Harry's first reaction animation). Nothing in the game reads it.

M6S00_OtherworldSpreadsGroundRising.description: Set at step 10 of the Otherworld-spreads scene of map6_s00 (the ground starts to rise) and cleared at its end. Nothing in the game reads it.

M6S00_OtherworldSpreadsNotAgainLine.description: Set at step 17 of the Otherworld-spreads scene of map6_s00, before Harry's line 'Not again... no, this time...'. Nothing in the game reads it.

M6S02_LighthouseStairAtPierDoor.description: Set while Harry is in the first sector of the lighthouse's spiral stair in map6_s02, at the door to the pier; cleared as soon as he moves on. While set the door back to map6_s00 (event 3) and its three neighbouring events work.

M6S02_ChannelingStoneUfoStarted.description: Set when the Channeling Stone UFO scene of map6_s02 starts (Cutscene_ChannelingStoneUfo, UFO5.DMS); the resort music then changes until M6S02_ChannelingStoneUsed.

M6S02_UfoEndingFadeStarted.description: Set at step 9 of the UFO ending (map6_s02 Cutscene_UfoEnding) when the long fade starts; the ending music changes layers.

M6S02_UfoEndingImageShown.description: Set six seconds into the final image phase of the UFO ending (map6_s02, before the credits); the ending music changes layers.

M6S01_BoatCabinEntered.description: Set when Harry first goes through the map6_s01 door at point 3 (room load to point 4) on the boat at the pier. It starts the scene with Cybil and Dahlia (event 8) and changes the music.

M6S01_CybilDahliaCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the boat scene with Cybil and Dahlia (map6_s01 Cutscene_LighthouseCybilDahlia). The map6_s00 manhole then says 'The cover has been removed...' (events 10-16), objects of map6_s00 change and the music changes.

M6S01_BoatReturnedAfterLighthouse.description: Completion flag of the map6_s00 door to the boat (map6_s01 point 6) that opens after the lighthouse scene (M6S02_LighthouseAlessaCutsceneDone). It starts the scene where Cybil leaves (map6_s01 event 9) and changes the music.

M6S01_CybilLeavesCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the boat scene after the lighthouse ('Cybil hasn't come back...', map6_s01 Cutscene_LighthouseCybilLeaves). It opens the manhole route (map6_s00 events 9-15 -> M6S00_ManholeCoverRemovedSeen), sets M6S01_ChannelingStoneUsed (map6_s01 event 14), starts FMV 9 when map6_s03 is entered, and changes the music.

M6S01_DahliaAppearedOnBoat.description: Set during the Cybil/Dahlia boat scene (map6_s01, step 19) when Dahlia is spawned; only the music mix reads it.

M6S02_FlashlightRestorePending.description: Set whenever map6_s02 (pier and lighthouse) loads; the next time map6_s00 loads it turns the flashlight back on and clears the flag.

M6S03_ArrivalAutosaveTaken.description: Set on the first map6_s03 tick after the post-hatch warp (M6S03_AfterHatchDescendWarpDone), together with an autosave snapshot, so the snapshot is taken once.

M6S03_FloorChangeSoundPlayed.description: One-shot in map6_s03: after the floor change (M6S03_SewerFloorChanged), the first tick Harry is at x <= 0 plays a sound at (-20, 0, 34), removes the enemies south of z = 36.5 m for good and sets the flag.

M6S03_HatchDescendCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the scene where Harry climbs down the hatch into the sewer to the amusement park (map6_s03 Cutscene_HatchDescend). It starts the warp to point 0 (event 5) and changes the music.

M6S03_AfterHatchDescendWarpDone.description: Completion flag of the map6_s03 warp to point 0 (AltSewer) after the hatch scene; it also triggers the one-time autosave (M6S03_ArrivalAutosaveTaken).

M6S03_HatchClimbUpCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the scene where Harry climbs the ladder out of the sewer at map6_s03 points 2-4 (Cutscene_HatchClimbUp). It starts the door to the amusement park (event 9, map6_s04).

M6S03_SewerTriggerAtPoint5Touched.description: Set by the touch trigger at map6_s03 point 5 (-20, 32) (event 10, EventSetFlag). Nothing in the game reads it.

M6S03_SewerFloorChanged.description: Set by the touch trigger at map6_s03 point 6 (-20, 50) (event 11). From then on the floor model YUKABFO1 is replaced by YUKAAFT1, the collision there changes, a sound plays once (M6S03_FloorChangeSoundPlayed), the trigger at point 9 marks the map (event 14) and the music changes.

M6S03_PickupMap.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the map on map6_s03 (Sewer to Lakeside Amusement Park) at map point 8 (x -22.0, z 26.4 m), event 12; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M6S03_HatchClimbUpStarted.description: Set at the first step of the climb out of the sewer (map6_s03 Cutscene_HatchClimbUp); the sewer music fades out with it.

M6S03_SewerEntryFmvSeen.description: Completion flag of FMV 9, played when map6_s03 is entered after Cybil left the boat (M6S01_CybilLeavesCutsceneDone).

M6S03_RearEnemiesCleared.description: One-shot in map6_s03: the first time Harry is past x = 48 m and a box around (40-44, 18-22) is off screen, every enemy behind him (x < 32 m) is removed and the flag is set.

M6S04_CybilBossArenaEntered.description: Set when Harry goes through the map6_s04 door at points 9/10 into the arena (point 7). It starts the Cybil boss intro (event 4) and selects the boss music track (39 instead of 37).

M6S04_CybilBossIntroCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the Cybil boss intro scene in the amusement park (map6_s04 Cutscene_CybilBossIntro). It starts FMV 8 (event 5).

M6S04_CybilBossFmvSeen.description: Completion flag of FMV 8 in the Cybil boss intro; it starts the scene where Cybil aims at Harry (event 6).

M6S04_CybilBossFightStarted.description: Set at the end of the scene where Cybil aims at Harry (map6_s04 Cutscene_CybilBossAims); the fight is on. If the map is loaded with it set and M6S04_CybilFightSetUp clear, event 7 resumes the fight without the scene.

M6S04_CybilBossPhaseThreeReached.description: Set by Monster Cybil when she enters her later fight phase (enter_phase_three). It starts the phase change scene (event 8) and changes the music.

M6S04_CybilBossPhaseChangeCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the Cybil boss phase change scene (map6_s04 Cutscene_CybilBossPhaseChange); the fight goes on with Cybil in her second mode and the music changes.

M6S04_CybilBossKilled.description: Set by Monster Cybil when her health reaches zero (Harry killed her instead of using the Unknown Liquid). It starts FMV 7 (event 9) and then the death scene.

M6S04_CybilDeathCutsceneDone.description: Set at the end of the scene after Cybil is killed (map6_s04 MapEvent_CutsceneCybilDeath).

M6S04_UnknownLiquidUsedOnCybil.description: Set when Harry uses the Unknown Liquid on Cybil during the boss fight in map6_s04 (item use within 0.7 m). It starts her exorcism scene (event 11, which sets M6S04_CybilSaved) and changes the music.

M6S04_CybilSaved.description: Cybil was saved: set at the end of the exorcism scene (Unknown Liquid used on her, event 11 M6S04_UnknownLiquidUsedOnCybil -> this). Read by the final maps (map7_s03) to pick the Good+/Bad+ endings, Cybil's part of the final boss intro and the ending scenes.

M6S04_CybilFightResolved.description: The Cybil boss fight is over either way: set at the end of Cybil's death scene and at the end of the exorcism scene. Required by event 12 (Alessa looks back scene).

M6S04_CutsceneDahliaTakesAlessaDone.description: The "I figured you'd show" scene (Harry raises the Flauros, it breaks, Dahlia takes Alessa) has ended and the Flauros was taken; gates event 3 which loads map7_s00 (Nowhere).

M6S04_FlaurosRaised.description: Temporary: set while the Flauros is held up in the Dahlia/Alessa scene (step 14) and cleared when Dahlia appears (step 45). While set the rocket ride by (8, -28) m is not animated.

M6S04_CutsceneAlessaLooksBackStarted.description: Set at the first step of the Alessa looks back scene (LOOKAR.DMS); from then on the park's wheel ride near (-16, -64) m is no longer animated.

M6S04_SmallFlaurosVisible.description: Temporary: while set the world update draws the small Flauros model at its scene pose (Flauros mode 1 of the Dahlia/Alessa scene); cleared otherwise.

M6S04_CarouselTurning.description: Outside the boss fight: set when the carousel starts turning because Cybil rides a horse, cleared when it stops. Used by the park music mix (track 39) before M6S04_CybilBossPhaseThreeReached.

M6S01_ChannelingStoneUsed.description: Channeling Stone used at the boat/pier spot of map6_s01 (point 12, UFO4.DMS). One of the four spots required for the UFO ending. Also set automatically by event 14 once M6S01_CybilLeavesCutsceneDone (Cybil left the lighthouse) is set, which closes this spot.

M6S02_ChannelingStoneUsed.description: Channeling Stone used at the lighthouse/pier spot of map6_s02 (point 8, UFO5.DMS). With the four other spots done this starts the UFO ending (M6S02_UfoEndingTriggered). Read by the map6 music mix.

M6S04_CutsceneCybilShootsStarted.description: Set at the first step of the scene after the park FMV where Cybil gets up, raises the gun and shoots (index 4, PARK.DMS frames 21..95). The park music mix (track 39) changes layers once it is set.

M6S04_CybilParasiteOut.description: Set during the exorcism scene when the parasite crawls out of Cybil (step 6); the park music mix adds a layer after it.

M6S04_CybilDeathLineShown.description: Set in Cybil's death scene once Harry's line (map6_s04.what_in_the_hell_how) has been dismissed; switches a music layer of track 39.

M6S04_FlaurosActivated.description: Set in the Dahlia/Alessa scene when the Flauros starts glowing (step 19, glow effects added); music cue for track 36.

M6S04_DahliaAppeared.description: Set in the Dahlia/Alessa scene when Dahlia is spawned (step 45, Flauros lowered); music cue for track 36.

M6S04_EntryAutosaveTaken.description: Set the first time the map's world update runs; at that moment the game copies the save to the autosave (continue point) once.

M6S04_CybilFightSetUp.description: The Cybil boss fight is set up (Monster Cybil placed, fight camera); set at the end of the scene that starts the fight, or by event 7 when the fight resumes without the scene (M6S04_CybilBossFightStarted set, this not). While M6S04_CybilBossFightStarted is set and this is not, the carousel is not updated.

M6S04_CutsceneAlessaLooksBackDone.description: The Alessa looks back scene (LOOKAR.DMS, event 12) has ended; required by event 13 (the Flauros / Dahlia scene).

M6S02_UfoEndingTriggered.description: Set when the Channeling Stone is used in map6_s02 while the four other spots are done (Flags 456-459); starts the UFO ending (event 10) and changes the stone scene and music.

M6S04_CybilDeathMovieSeen.description: The movie played after Cybil is killed (event 9: M6S04_CybilBossKilled -> this, FMV param 7 = disc movie MB_04850) has been shown; leads to Cybil's death scene (event 10).

M6S00_HealthDrink.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the health drink on map6_s00 (Resort Area Otherworld) at map point 22 (x -44.6, z 143.3 m), event 0; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M6S00_ShotgunShells.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the shotgun shells on map6_s00 (Resort Area Otherworld) at map point 23 (x -43.4, z 142.4 m), event 1; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M6S00_FirstAidKit.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the first aid kit on map6_s00 (Resort Area Otherworld) at map point 24 (x -163.8, z -76.3 m), event 2; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M6S01_RifleShells.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the rifle shells on map6_s01 (Boat at Lakeside Pier) at map point 13 (x -18.6, z 57.0 m), event 0; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M6S01_HandgunBullets.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the handgun bullets on map6_s01 (Boat at Lakeside Pier) at map point 14 (x -18.3, z 58.8 m), event 1; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M6S01_HealthDrink.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the health drink on map6_s01 (Boat at Lakeside Pier) at map point 15 (x -19.5, z 57.1 m), event 2; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M6S03_HealthDrink0.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the health drink on map6_s03 (Sewer to Lakeside Amusement Park) at map point 10 (x 20.9, z 75.5 m), event 0; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M6S03_HandgunBullets.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the handgun bullets on map6_s03 (Sewer to Lakeside Amusement Park) at map point 11 (x 18.6, z 75.2 m), event 1; once set the pickup is gone for good.

M6S03_HealthDrink1.description: Pickup: set when Harry takes the health drink on map6_s03 (Sewer to Lakeside Amusement Park) at map point 12 (x 26.4, z 60.2 m), event 2; once set the pickup is gone for good.
